purpose: Record human feedback that redirects the Codex-native paper-to-skill workflow.

focus_updates.user_feedback_zh: 强化 Wasserstein error、coupling bias 和可复用 proof pattern。
focus_updates.user_feedback_en: Prioritize Wasserstein error, coupling bias, and reusable proof patterns.
focus_updates.effect_on_workflow: Retrieval, triage, extraction, and synthesis should prefer theory papers with transferable error-analysis or coupling arguments.

focus_updates.user_feedback_zh: 阅读优先级应更多看 proof-pattern value，而不是只看主题相关。
focus_updates.user_feedback_en: Reading priority should weigh proof-pattern value more heavily than topical similarity alone.
focus_updates.effect_on_workflow: Triage should rank papers with reusable proof techniques above papers that are merely adjacent applications.

negative_preferences.user_feedback_zh: 弱化 heavy-tailed prior 本身，不把它作为独立主线。
negative_preferences.user_feedback_en: Down-rank heavy-tailed priors as a standalone research line.
negative_preferences.effect_on_workflow: Retriever should keep heavy-tailed prior papers only when they contribute useful error-analysis or proof techniques.

negative_preferences.user_feedback_zh: 不要找太多纯实验型 flow matching paper。
negative_preferences.user_feedback_en: Avoid over-selecting purely empirical flow matching papers.
negative_preferences.effect_on_workflow: Retriever and triage should down-rank benchmark-only or application-only papers unless they are needed for positioning.

paper_decisions.title: An Error Analysis of Flow Matching for Deep Generative Modeling
paper_decisions.reason: High proof-pattern value for Wasserstein error bounds and learned-flow error propagation.

paper_decisions.title: Error Bounds for Flow Matching Methods
paper_decisions.reason: Core theory paper for approximation-error-to-sampling-error proof patterns.

paper_decisions.title: Purely empirical flow matching papers
paper_decisions.reason: Keep only if needed for positioning; do not prioritize for Skill extraction.

skill_decisions.reason: Central reusable proof pattern for converting flow or velocity-field error into Wasserstein error.
Useful but should be checked for assumptions before being promoted to a library Skill.

next_step_directives.directive: Use proof-technique and Wasserstein-error queries before broad flow-matching application queries.
Search for transferable error-analysis, coupling, lower-bound, and regularity techniques.
Let proof-pattern value and source evidence quality dominate recency or application proximity.
Prioritize proof spans that turn approximation, coupling, or velocity-field errors into Wasserstein or total-variation guarantees.
Merge around reusable proof mechanisms, not around paper-specific model families.

stage_feedback_log.human_feedback_summary_zh: 研究兴趣应从具体 prior 设定转向 Wasserstein error、coupling bias 和证明套路。
stage_feedback_log.human_feedback_summary_en: The research interest should shift from a specific prior setting toward Wasserstein error, coupling bias, and proof patterns.

stage_feedback_log.human_feedback_summary_zh: 优先下载和抽取两篇高 proof-pattern value 的 error-bound paper。
stage_feedback_log.human_feedback_summary_en: Prioritize downloading and extracting two error-bound papers with high proof-pattern value.

stage_feedback_log.human_feedback_summary_zh: 优先保留可泛化到 Wasserstein / flow stability 的 Skill，其他经验过程类 Skill 先标记复核。
stage_feedback_log.human_feedback_summary_en: Keep skills generalizing to Wasserstein or flow-stability arguments first; mark empirical-process skills for review.
